title: Linear Probe Accuracy Scales with Model Size and Benefits from Multi-Layer Ensembling
reasoning: The paper focuses on a technical methodology for detecting deceptive activations in language models using linear probes and ensembling. While it addresses concepts such as deception and honesty, which have moral implications, its primary focus is on AI safety and mechanistic interpretability (probing internal activations) rather than evaluating or benchmarking religious, spiritual, or formal philosophical ethical systems.
